#+title: A rule kept in a generated file is erased by the next regeneration
#+description: Why a rule written into a generated file disappears, and where it belongs instead.
#+type: memory
#+memory_subtype: feedback
#+level: cross
#+filetags: :memory:feedback:
#+created: 2026-10-31
#+updated: 2026-10-31

A rule that only a generated file carries is lost when that file is regenerated, and nothing fails until something walks the store.

*Why:* Generation rewrites the file from its model, so a hand edit has no place to survive; the row still compiles, so the loss is silent and only a round trip that reads the value back notices it.

*How to apply:* State the rule in the model and render it from the template, then regenerate. When that is too large for the change at hand, add a gate that fails when the rule is missing, and re-apply the edit after every regeneration until then. Let the drift gate run: it names the generated files the tree holds and the model does not produce.
